about: This page is React (src/pages/characters/CharactersPage.jsx). tools/split-map.js stops generating it, drops the legacy code and modal below, and fails if anything left still calls them. The character sheet, casting and plate tools stay in core; they call loadCharacters() and editCharacter() by name, which the page registers on window (editCharacter is PROVIDED). describeFromScreenplay, the subjects chunk's only function, is src/lib/subjects.js now that all three subject pages are React.
